beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Riley's back, the tour further along, her old band's offer well behind her now.

options.text: You're still living inside the thing you've been growing.
This means the songs stopped mattering.
The present has nothing to do with that.

elaboration: The Empress doesn't close once something's shared — you're still standing inside what you grew, and that's exactly what the present position means here.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "So does the Fool in my future mean everything I built with the songs stops mattering — like I'm starting completely over?"

options.text: No — it's about what's opening up next, not erasing what came before.
Yes, it wipes the slate clean.
It has nothing to do with what's ahead.

elaboration: The Fool in the future position isn't erasing the ground you grew — it's pointing at the fresh start that ground is about to open onto.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "How does something I've been quietly growing lead to a whole fresh start, though?"

options.text: Growing it all the way is what clears room for the next leap.
It doesn't — the two cards contradict each other.
The Empress cancels out whatever the Fool says.

elaboration: Standing fully in what you've grown is exactly what makes room for the next leap — the Empress ripened something so the Fool has ground to jump from.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "What if the thing I've been growing changes completely once the tour ends?"

options.text: That's fine — abundance means letting it flourish, not staying fixed.
Change means it was never real to begin with.

elaboration: Abundance that comes from allowing things to flourish, not forcing them — that includes letting it turn into something you didn't originally picture.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Okay. I think I finally get it — the thing I started growing before all this isn't finished, it just found its next leap. Thank you for that."
